_role: One blind seat's raw record. The canonical clause-6 file for this commit merges the seats and deliberately carries EMPTY tallies, so clause 1's derivation over the glob counts each finding exactly once.
_blind_means: Given the document path and the pinned sha and nothing else. Forbidden research/autonomy/, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, STRATEGY.md, the program map, every skill file and every commit message. Instructed to refute by default and told there is no wanted answer. Dispatched concurrently at subagent_width=5 by CYC-0017, which had not authored or applied any fix to this paper.
lens: Every printed quantity re-derived from the artifact that produces it, with the seat's own Wilson and Fisher implementations rather than the generator's.
central_claim: The NR4A3 5' fusion partner is a CANDIDATE, not established, stratification variable in EMC, and the two halves are in different states. Prognosis: 7/15 = 46.7 % vs 6/58 = 10.3 %, 36.3 points, post-hoc Fisher p = 0.0034, simultaneously defeated by Huang's own multivariable model where the partner loses to tumour size (>10 cm, HR 30.60) and metastasis at presentation (HR 8.14). Response: 0 of 3 to 0 of 5 TAF15 patients, Wilson upper bound 43.4–56.1 % sitting ABOVE the comparator arm's own point estimate — a direction only, no magnitude. Prevalence pools at 28/154 = 18.2 % (12.9–25.0). It does NOT establish non-response, an independent prognostic effect, mechanism, or anything about local recurrence or metastasis in either direction; it is not a meta-analysis and makes no treatment recommendation.

p1s.where: §1.1 '"EMCs are translocation sarcomas and harbor in > 90% of the cases an NR4A3 rearrangement" [12]' against the banner 'Every number below has one home: emc-fusion-partner-pooling.json'
p1s.finding: The '> 90%' figure has NO field anywhere in emc-fusion-partner-pooling.json — '90' occurs in that file only inside '95%'. The document's opening universality claim is measurably false inside the document. The figure itself is NOT wrong: the verbatim sentence is Bangerter 2022's abstract and is held in three other tracked artifacts, so this is provenance/coverage, not claim integrity.
